structured.answer: A deposit means you lock money in the bank for a set time and get interest (the example says 1.8%, minus 15% tax). You give up access, because breaking it early costs a fine the site doesn't calculate. Their own example showed 70,000 ₪ in and 68,270 ₪ left, so I'm not doing it today.

stuck.why: 'ההפקדות שלכם 70,000 ₪' vs 'נשאר לכם 68,270 ₪' looks like you lose money; only the small 'בכסף של היום' toggle and 2% inflation vs 1.8% hint why
Exit fee only says 'לפי התעריפון של הגורם המציע', no shekel amount
Says early break has a קנס but 'האתר לא מחשב אותה', so I can't tell what locking away really costs
